title: Quick German Beef or Fish Hash
description: A hearty, quick-fix German dish that can be made with beef or fish, featuring a mustardy and springy flavor profile. Brown sugar and nimono-simmer add a depth of flavor. Pescatarian-friendly and perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Fish (1 lb)
ingredients.notes: Choose a firm white fish like cod or tilapia.

ingredients.name: Nimono-simmer (1 cup)
ingredients.notes: Can be substituted with chicken broth or beef broth if necessary.

instructions: Cut the beef or fish into 1-inch cubes and set aside.
Cut the onion, carrots, and potatoes into 1-inch pieces.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add a small amount of oil.
Add the beef or fish to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
